mainImage.alt: Basque Ertzaintza police officers swinging batons at pro-Palestinian activists on the floor of Bilbao airport arrivals hall. Several people are on the ground. Others are scrambling away.
mainImage.caption: RTVE — Basque Ertzaintza police charge and beat pro-Palestinian activists at Bilbao airport on May 23, 2026, as they welcome returning members of the Global Sumud Flotilla.

body.alt: Israeli minister Itamar Ben Gvir holding Israeli flag and smiling while rows of detained flotilla activists kneel on the ground with hands bound behind their backs at Ashdod port.
body.caption: Screenshot/Ben Gvir's X account via Times of Israel — Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir taunts detained Global Sumud Flotilla activists forced to kneel with hands zip-tied behind their backs at an Ashdod port detention facility, May 20, 2026.
body.credit: Screenshot/Ben Gvir's X account via Times of Israel

body.alt: Freed Global Sumud Flotilla activists receiving medical assistance at Istanbul Airport after release from Israeli detention. One person lies on a stretcher.
body.caption: AFP via Times of Israel — Freed Global Sumud Flotilla activists receive medical assistance at Istanbul Airport after being released from Israeli detention on May 21, 2026.
